title: Signature NVIDIA Triton Inference Server: What Triton Is: The Model Server Standard
description: The Signature counterpart is the SigHall server, Manon's original inference-serving design. SigHall mirrors the repository-plus-scheduler architecture but adds a capacity contract: every model registers its worst-case latency and memory, and the scheduler provably refuses load beyond the contract. The Signature design makes overload a 503 with a reason, never a silent slowdown.

t: Signature NVIDIA Triton Inference Server: Dynamic Batching: Throughput Without Waiting
title: Signature NVIDIA Triton Inference Server: Dynamic Batching: Throughput Without Waiting
description: SigHall's batcher is the muster: it forms batches against a declared latency SLO and publishes the batching histogram. The Signature design makes the SLO load-bearing — if the muster cannot meet the SLO at current load, it sheds with explicit 503s instead of letting tail latency explode silently.
